answer_1.quote: For the open-ended task, we use two text generation datasets: BOLD and REALTOXICITYPROMPTS... We also conduct evaluations on two common tasks, knowledge-based question answering and text summarization.
answer_1.outputs: generated text evaluated for bias, sentiment, and toxicity

answer_2.quote: we adopt the Sentiment Reasoner (Vader) score S_VAD... and the toxicity score S_TOX from a widely used toxicity classifier (PERSPECTIVE API)...

answer_3.quote: We additionally evaluate these samples with human annotators and an LLM based judge (GPT-4.1-mini) for comparison.

answer_4.quote: All human annotations are performed by team members with graduate-level education backgrounds... annotators familiarize themselves with the scoring standards of the automatic tools, while during the annotation process, they make holistic judgments based on both word choice and overall semantics.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed the official definitions of sentiment (VADER) and toxicity (Perspective API) and made holistic judgments of the generated texts.
